CHANNEL: MONEY PURSE

VIDEO DESCRIPTION:
Do you leave WhatsApp Web logged in after using it? If someone else gets access to that computer while your session is still active, they could read your chats or send messages from your account.

In this video, Money Purse explains the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) warning about unauthorized access to WhatsApp Web and the simple steps you can take to protect your account.
- Log out after using WhatsApp Web, especially on shared or public computers.
- Open WhatsApp on your phone and check Linked Devices.
- If you see a device you don’t recognize, tap it and select Log out.
Share this video with friends and family who use WhatsApp Web. Subscribe to Money Purse for more digital safety updates.
